summary: Tested the Training Plan action-button feature end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass covering GET /api/plan/progress (shape + per-week done/current flags relative to you_are_here=4), GET /api/plan/adaptations (seed entry + coach filter), PUT /api/plan/goals (persistence verified via subsequent GET /api/plan), and POST /api/coach/adaptation with refresh=true (ONE LLM call — returned cached=false and appended a new 'Manual refresh' entry visible via /api/plan/adaptations). Frontend: at /plan on tablet-landscape (1366x900), EditGoalsModal opens on 'Edit Goals' tap, supports goal-toggle, goal-title / goal-desc edit, goal-add (5 goals) and goal-delete (back to 4); Save (testID goals-save) closed the modal and the Goals card immediately reflected the edits (TEST_UI_Goal_Edited and TEST_UI_Added shown). ProgressModal (testID view-progress) opens with progress ring, CTL/ATL chart, KEY METRICS grid and WEEKLY COMPLETION bars; close via testID modal-close works. AdaptationsModal (testID view-adaptations) opens showing the timeline including the 'Manual refresh' entry generated during backend refresh test; backdrop dismiss works. Original 4 goals restored via API after UI test as required.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents="none"` on Animated.View. RN warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/plan.tsx:32

Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Grep for textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius in /app/frontend/src/components/plan.tsx (or related) and migrate to the new single `textShadow` shorthand.

action_items: Optional: migrate `<Animated.View pointerEvents="none" ...>` in plan.tsx Toast to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` (or wrap with an outer View) to silence the RN deprecation warning.
Optional: replace deprecated `textShadowColor/Offset/Radius` style props with the new `textShadow` shorthand in plan components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1190 lines and mixes plan/calendar/hub/telemetry/coach concerns — consider splitting into routers (plan.py, calendar.py, coach.py, hub.py) for maintainability.

_record_adaptation upserts with $push on a missing doc will fail on some Mongo versions if no matching doc exists (it currently upserts, but the training_plans doc is always seeded first via /api/plan or coach_adaptation flow, so fine). Worth an explicit seed in _record_adaptation for defensive coverage.
PlanGoal model does not restrict `status` to an enum; malformed values (e.g. 'done') would be persisted. Consider Literal['complete','incomplete'].
seed_data_creation: None. During tests I mutated /api/plan/goals but restored the original 4 goals both after the backend test (test_restore_original_goals) and after the UI test via a direct PUT — verified via GET /api/plan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully functional. When re-testing, remember: POST /api/coach/adaptation with refresh:true consumes LLM credits — call at most once. testIDs to use: view-progress, view-adaptations, goals-save, goals-cancel, goal-toggle-<id>, goal-title-<id>, goal-desc-<id>, goal-delete-<id>, goal-add, modal-close.
